large_unit: validate that W6 large-unit behavior changes admission timing even when the survival target is unchanged
finding: For a 20m hard budget with provisional 60s close reserve, admission deadline is task-size-dependent: estimated 180s unit latest start=16m; 120s unit=17m; 60s unit=18m; 30s unit=18m30s. Therefore PRODUCTIVE_CAP should not be represented solely by one fixed timestamp unless policy intentionally chooses P1/P2 simplicity over utilization.
